text.p: Bonds were trading quietly firmer in line with the rest of Europe but with traders seeing some room for the spread with the 10 year Bund to narrow slightly.
"Europe is stronger so we are following. The main factor is the apparent steadying of the dollar around 1.85 marks," said one trader.
Traders said that even if the dollar was a little stronger than Friday it was below the highs seen last week.
"If the dollar stabilises at current levels, we could see a narrowing of the spread (with the Bund). But a clearer trend will emerge only after the U.S. opens," said one trader.
The shorter end was calm, with a tendency for the curve to flatten given the relative lack of interest.
